description: A static HTML page with independent interactive widgets (islands) that ship JavaScript and hydrate on their own.
Hydrating only some parts of the page instead of the whole document. Static parts ship zero JavaScript.
The element that wraps an island's server HTML and records the component and its serialized props (`data-island`, Astro's `<astro-island>`).
Astro's `client:load`, `client:idle`, `client:visible`, `client:media` and `client:only` decide whether and when a component hydrates.
Props that survive JSON: strings, numbers, booleans, arrays and plain objects. Functions and class instances cannot cross into an island.
Astro's `server:defer`: a personalized fragment rendered separately on the server and inserted into an otherwise cached page.
